title: Fuel Circuit
commonMistakes: Simulating every starting station, which is quadratic
Resetting the tank without considering the total fuel balance
Returning a start when the total fuel is less than the total cost
Forgetting that the circuit wraps around to the beginning
followUps: How would you return every valid starting station if several exist?
What changes if stations can be visited only once rather than in a loop?
How would you handle fuel capacity limits at each station?
attribution: Original problem by the Base Case contributors.
